anomaly_label: Decreased distillate flow to distillate receiver (V003)

evidence.observation: Before the transient, system pressure was 499.7 mbar, column differential pressure 0.6 mbar and buffer differential pressure 3.0 mbar.
System pressure abruptly fell to 284.284 mbar while column differential pressure spiked to 18.626 mbar; vessel and column temperatures fell concurrently.
System pressure reached 255.33 mbar and buffer differential pressure rose to 7.119 mbar.
Latest pressures have stabilized near 300.2, -0.1 and 3.0 mbar respectively, with T703 at 60.5 C and T705 at 52.4 C; this is a different operating state from the initial baseline.

args.missing_evidence: Pressure setpoint and valve/pump command history are needed to distinguish an intended pressure transition from a process upset; independent pressure checks would validate the differential-pressure excursion. No composition measurement or separation target is provided, and distillate, reflux and cooling-water flow sensors are not installed.
